title: Senna

title: Hunger
why: Bobby Sands dies on the 66th day of his hunger strike, 5 May 1981.

title: The Hindenburg
why: Lakehurst, New Jersey, 6 May 1937. 'Oh, the humanity.'

title: A Royal Night Out
